analysis: corrected secondary held-out validation (TC-1); historical path preserved in run.py
cohort: GSE131907 (Kim et al. 2020 metastatic LUAD atlas)

decision_rule_inputs.rule: SUPPORTED if pooled delta > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05

design.normalization: log1p-CPM(1e6) float64; genes detected in >=5 cells

normalization_facts.denominator: full raw library before gene filtering

modified_hk.note: sensitivity only; not a replacement for the preregistered DL interval

exclusions.note: non-estimable projection SEs (degenerate separations) are excluded from inverse-variance pooling EXPLICITLY and reported descriptively — no variance floor is applied

patient_unit_evidence.source: GEO GSE131907 Lung_Cancer_Feature_Summary.xlsx, FeatureSummary columns B/C, rows 4-61

protocol_decision.rule: preregistered one-sided: delta > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05
